control_655.controlData:
Attribute Definitions

Add an attribute and assign the corresponding weight below by clicking on the Add Attribute button or adjust the weight of an existing attribute by clicking on a row in the table.

control_658.controlData: Select an attribute from the dropdown menu to filter the table below. Click on a row in the table to adjust the criteria, minimum, and maximum or add new criteria by clicking the Add Criteria button.
